newsitem.title: JAPAN: Daiwa Sec denies media report of illicit deals.
newsitem.headline: Daiwa Sec denies media report of illicit deals.

text.p: Daiwa Securities Co Ltd on Wednesday denied a newspaper report that it provided a total of 200 million yen to a "sokaiya" racketeer through illicit deals.
"We don't think that we did anything reported in the article," a Daiwa spokesman said.

On Wednesday, the Japanese business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun quoted what it said were sources close to the case as saying that Daiwa provided about 200 million yen to racketeer Ryuichi Koike through illegal deals in about 1993 to offset some of his stock trading losses.
Daiwa shares stood at 831 yen at midday on Wednesday, down 34 yen from Tuesday's close.
